name: Aida
note: The world's manifest (docs/order-plan.md, sprint D). `show` is MapShow, read by game/world/world_show.cpp: what the client draws, plays and hears here. A system opens only where its field is set. Copied to assets/world/<w>/world.json by tools/sync.sh.

air.note: No weather and no wind for now (GMAida.cpp, SceneManager.cpp:371-402).

indoors.note: No open sky on any tile (MU draws it on its black clear, SceneManager.cpp:402).

waterfall_spray.note: Its falls' drops, spray and mist (game/world/waterfall_spray.h).

hidden.note: Aida's nine (MoveAidaObject, GMAida.cpp:77-86; 60 in RenderAidaObjectVisual :195-204): 56, 57 and 58 the waterfall spray boxes, 84 of them; 59, 62 and 63 the mist boxes, 91, which never emit in MU (their emitter is gated on the HiddenMesh the move sets first, :184-226); 60 the butterflies, 20; 67 the small fires, 11; 70 the skull ghost, 5. All emitters, drawn by no mesh. docs/aida-port.md.

grass.note: Aida ships TileGrass01.OZT, dark olive blades, which MU grows on slot 0 (ZzzLodTerrain.cpp:2077-2120), 14 473 drawn tiles; TileGrass02.OZT is fully transparent, so slot 1 grows nothing. docs/aida-port.md.

void.note: Aida: Devias's way, as Tarkan. A NoGround ravine from the entrance to the north-east, walled by Object18-20's 13 m rock faces sunk about 4.7 m, with 40 waterfalls falling into it. Deeper than Tarkan's because the walls and falls reach 4.7-6 m down. And `blend`: where no wall or rock stands on a lip, MU leaves the tile edge as a jagged cut against the black (the user, 2026-10-11: 'there still was some black holes', then 'Soft fade on bare inner edges'), so the ground goes dark into the void over a tile and a half. Only the ground's own shader reads it (abyssEdge, fs_ground), so the walls and rocks on the lips keep their light. No `rim`, which slopes the lips and would hide the walls. docs/aida-port.md, Part B 5.

void_fill.note: Aida, from the safe hall: 177 open tiles in seven crumbs on rows 253-255 that no walk reaches, beyond the walls. docs/aida-port.md.
